full_judgment:
LATIFUR RAHMAN, J :- This petition by the principal opposite party-petitioner is against the Judgment and order dated 23th August. 1995 passed by High Court Division in civil Revision Nos. 907, 908, 912, 913 and 917 of 1989 discharging the Rules after affirming the judgment and order of the Appellate court passed in Five Miscellaneous Appeals on 28.5.89 setting aside the order of Munsif , in five Miscellaneous cases on 30.12.82 ordering abatement for non-substitution in pre-emption proceedings under section 96 of the state Acquisition and Tenancy Act. 

 2. Facts briefly are that. Five Miscellaneous cases bearing nos. 68, 78, 171, 105 and 186 of 1981 were filed under section s96 of the state Acquisition and Tenancy act for pre-emption During pendency of these cases opposite party No. 2 Kusai Mondal, opposite Party No. 13 Haji Abdul Gafur and opposite party No. 22 paran died leaving behind heirs. The heirs were not substituted in any of those Miscellaneous cases. The petitioners of all these cases filed petitions in the respective cases for striking out the names of the deceased opposite parties. After hearing both parties the trial court rejected the prayer for striking out the names of deceased opposite parties on the ground that the Miscellaneous cases already abated for not substituting the heirs of those deceased opposite parties.
